newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Celsius unit wins 625 mln skr Brazil rig order.
newsitem.headline: Celsius unit wins 625 mln skr Brazil rig order.

text.p: Celsius Invest, part of the Swedish defence industries firm Celsius AB, said on Thursday its subsidiary Gotaverken Arendal AB won a contract from Brazilian oil company Petrobras for an offshore oil rig.
Celsius said in a statement the contract was worth 625 million crowns.
The contract is for a complete rebuilding of offshore Brazil drilling platform Petrobras XXIII built by Gotaverken Arendal, which is currently on charter to Petrobras for 10 years.

It is being rebuilt as a deep water driller which can drill down to 1,500 metres. Rebuilding work is due to be completed in February 1998. The rig will be chartered to Petrobras until 2008 for offshore drill operation.
Several major shipyards are tendering for the rebuilding works.
